source.title: Skewb: New Event in 2014
source.content:
The WCA Board has approved the addition of Skewb as an official WCA event, to take effect with the new Regulations on January 1, 2014.
 See the [announcement in the WCA forum](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=1163) for details.

translation.title: 斜转将于 2014 年成为 WCA 正式项目
translation.content:
WCA 董事会已批准将斜转列为 WCA 正式项目，自 2014 年 1 月 1 日起随新版规则一同生效。

详情请见 [WCA 论坛公告](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=1163)。
